Amended Protocol Version 02 exposes randomized, safety and full analysis sets, the primary logistic model, nonresponder handling, supportive CMH analysis, ANCOVA and LOCF secondary analyses, interim timing and the powered 250-patient sample size (physical PDF pages 19-21 and 73-77). SAP Amendment 2.0 is also dated 2018-12-31 after actual primary and study completion on 2018-12-05.
